Single Bowl Electric Mini Grinder Food Chopper | Best Quality Food Chopper ( Random Color )

 	SAVE YOU TIME: his food processor is very simple and easy to use. Press and hold the top button to start the motor, and release it to stop, it makes you control the degree of food shred, very user-friendly. Ingredients such as garlic and onion can be chopped in just a few seconds. Wide range of application, all kinds of onion, ginger, garlic and chili can be crushed.
 	POWERFUL FOOD PROCESSOR: 45W low?power powerful motor, full stirring, effective noise reduction, has long service life. The stainless steel S?shaped blade is designed with a 35?degree angle, which has good crushing performance and full release of nutrition. It is suitable for a baby’s supplementary meal. The baby has a small appetite. Each meal should be of freshness and the portion is just right.
 	HEALTHY & SAFETY: Electric garlic chopper comes with a food grade ABS blender cup and a 304 stainless steel blade .The cover, bowl, and chopping blades of the small food processor can be removed, easy to clean. For safe use, the cup must be aligned with the position of the body and rotated to the safety lock position to activate the guarantee.
 	USB CHARGING & PORTABLE: The mini vegetable chopper is powered by USB, and the garlic chopper vegetable can be charged in a variety of ways, such as mobile power, Computers and laptops etc. Small size, easy to use at home and outdoors. Mini and stylish design, which is very suitable for home, kitchen, traveling, camping etc.



KEY FEATURES



 	USB Rechargeable: Electric food chopper, powered by 1 x 3.7V rechargeable battery(Built-in), USB rechargeable .Press the button to automatically stir the food, save your time and release your hands.
 	Multifunction: About 100ml, with 2 sharp blades, it can chop garlic, ginger, peppers, vegetables, fruits, meats and more. Small chopper is also easy for you to store.
 	Material: Made of PP material, food-grade cup body, non-toxic plastic, safe for containing food.
 	Safety Design: The cup is aligned with the main body position and rotated to a safe locked position to start using, suitable for small kitchens.
 	Easy Clean: Waterproof design. The whole body is waterproof and easy to clean.
